info.headline: Cyclone Alert — Tropical Cyclone approaching Rivertown coast
info.description: Tropical Cyclone "Varun" (Category 3) is approaching the Rivertown coast. Landfall expected within 24 hours near 19.08N, 72.87E. Wind speeds up to 140 km/h. Storm surge of 2-3 meters expected in low-lying coastal areas.
info.instruction: Secure loose objects. Stock emergency supplies. Charge phones. Follow evacuation orders when issued. Fishermen advised not to venture into sea.
